question: Must successful exact-run release-ledger validation be a hard prerequisite for release publication before this PR lands?
rationale: The ledger workflow explicitly has no publication authority, so release-owner intent is needed to decide whether the trusted publisher must enforce the new evidence contract rather than relying on an operator hold.

options.title: Gate publication on the ledger
options.body: Require ledger run and artifact inputs, invoke the validator before publication, and test absent, stale, and mismatched evidence failures.

options.title: Accept a manual-only control
options.body: Keep validation operator-driven and explicitly accept that repository automation cannot prevent publication bypass.

recommendation.title: Gate publication on the ledger
recommendation.body: Require ledger run and artifact inputs, invoke the validator before publication, and test absent, stale, and mismatched evidence failures.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced most of the trusted publication validation boundary where this release-policy decision must be enforced.
